headlines.title: Port of Los Angeles Sets All-Time Monthly Cargo Record
headlines.content_summary: The Port of Los Angeles handled 1,042,652 Twenty-Foot Equivalent Units (TEUs) in September, the busiest month in its 118-year history and more than 20,000 units more than the previous monthly record set in July 2025. The record month also capped the busiest quarter in Port history, with nearly 3 million TEUs moving across its docks ...

headlines.title: KIFFA, UPA 국제물류 청년취업 아카데미 입교식

headlines.title: 신현송, 레버리지 ETF 논란 관련 "국민께 송구"(종합)
